title: The Drownlight - Relit
_note: Drownlight family RELIGHT (flag:drownlight_relit): the keeper's hymn turned MAJOR — D major, 3/4, 84 BPM — whole and warm. Flute and a bell double the motif, strings swell under it, the harp arpeggios open up, a soft processional kick and hat, a crash on the downbeat. The lamp turns again. Loops back to bar 1 from the tonic.
